name: track4-vol-magnitude-into-kalshi-strikes
status: FROZEN — amendments prohibited; supersede only via a new prereg with a new name

gates_passed_before_freeze.step0_liquidity: PASS 2026-07-11 — KXBTCD ATM: 1c spread, ~2.4k contracts within 2c/side, 292,699 contracts/24h; KXETHD ATM: 1c spread, 8,567 ct/24h (artifact /data/logs/track4_step0_*.txt)
gates_passed_before_freeze.step1_mi_screen: PASS 2026-07-11 — rv_15m vs next-15m |move|: spearman 0.296 (sd 0.044), sign 17/17 days, excess MI 0.098 bits; all rv/range features clear threshold at 15m and 60m (artifact /data/logs/track4_step1_*.txt)

hypothesis: Trailing realized volatility predicts |move| magnitude (vol clustering). Kalshi BTC/ETH threshold (above/below) markets misprice tail strikes when current vol regime deviates from unconditional, because quoted prices underreact to short-horizon rv changes.

instruments.selection: markets closing within 26h, strike within +/-3% of spot
instruments.executable_price: buy-yes at yes_ask; buy-no at (1 - yes_bid); provenance = strike_logger orderbook snapshot at fire time; NO fallback — book one-sided or stale (>90s) => no fire, logged with reason

target: P(settle yes) = P(spot_at_close >= strike) for threshold markets, label derived deterministically from Coinbase spot at close vs strike (venue settlement backfill as verification)
model_class: L2-regularized logistic regression on the frozen features, isotonic-calibrated; trained on historical Coinbase spot (labels derived from spot paths, no market prices needed for training); NO architecture search, NO feature additions post-freeze

evaluation.design: forward-only: model may be trained/calibrated on any data BEFORE the collector start timestamp; EV evaluated exclusively on executable prices collected forward by strike_logger
evaluation.cluster: close_ts (all strikes and underlyings sharing an expiry co-move)
evaluation.pass_rule: mean EV per fired contract > 0 with cluster-robust 95% CI-low > 0 at >= 200 effective clusters; else DEAD — no 'one more week'
evaluation.min_fires: if < 50 fires by checkpoint, report fire-rate reality and extend collection (not the rule) by at most 7 days, once

kill_criteria: week-1 CI-low <= 0 => hypothesis dead, document, next hypothesis (Track 4 rule: 3 consecutive dead => program review)
median executable spread on fired markets > 3c during week 1 => liquidity regression, dead
collector uptime < 80% in week 1 => data invalid, restart clock once, else dead

disk_budget.action_on_breach: raise cadence to 60s; never silently drop fields
